_doc: #1925 Sokolniki step 4: finish zones, UV and NPM atlas on the accepted body v006 + assembly v009 [D409]. One spec serves tools/blender/vpm_uv.py (texel cuts, periodic UDIM per finish, path B: one finish = one UDIM tile, stacked islands [D320]) and tools/derive/npm_atlas.py (dt derive atlas). Finishes = PDF finish passport (СОКОЛЬНИКИ_УВК1000_АР_R23_вар1.pdf legend 1-12); rgb = approximate RAL sRGB, not measured; all patterns are the shared painter's (SYNTHETIC look: brick / porcelain / cassette joints, curtain-wall and window impost step as a periodic grid, mesh as the shared 'cage' opacity grid). Address is a placeholder (no confirmed NPM address).

08_door_RAL7016.passport: двери витражные, профиль RAL 7016: полотна, фрамуги, стёкла - рисунок по схеме Revit [D417]

zoning._doc: PDF elevations (1-169, 14-170, D1-A1): N wing = dark brick 1 (plinth 0-0.6 porcelain 2), D = light cassettes 3 above the porcelain 2 ground floor (to +3.84), S = light cassettes 3 above a dark brick 1 ground floor (to +3.04), H = light cassettes 3. Dark/light joints fall on the existing N|D and S|D volume corners and on the existing lattice levels 0.6 / 3.04 / 3.84 (no new cut). Jambs, sills, heads, soffits = reveal 11; parapet tops and inner parapet / well walls = flashing 14; up-facing ledges >= 4 m2 = roof.

window_texture._doc: #1925 r4 [D417] (Artem: windows are shown as texture on the facade): each v009 window / door face maps by the box of its Revit instance onto a whole-window drawing (Revit glass panes, the rest is RAL 7016 profile) in a trim cell of the finish tile; no frame geometry. Rows from `inset_write_blender.py winscan` + `inset_build.py wintex`; faces without an instance get the `_face` drawing on their own extent.

cw._doc: r5 [D418]: curtain-wall faces of finishes 05 / 06 (cwscan): small (<= small_max_m) drawn like windows, large on their Revit mullion / transom grid; no Revit panels = grid_pitch_m bays with transoms at the Revit transom levels
